title: Summary of Residential Tenancy Terms

headings.text: 3. What the tenant agrees to do
4. What the landlord agrees to do

key_sentences: This summary sets out the main terms of the tenancy agreement signed on 12 November 2026.
It does not replace the agreement itself, and if the two differ the agreement applies.
The holding fee of 230.00 is credited against the first month's rent, so the first payment is 920.00.
Either party may end the tenancy after the first six months by giving two months' written notice.
The tenant must return all keys on the last day and leave the property clean and clear of belongings.
The deposit is returned within ten days of the end of the tenancy, less any agreed deductions.
The items below were checked together on the day of the inspection.
Signed copies of the agreement and the inventory are kept by both parties.

rows: 1,150.00 per calendar month, payable in advance
Small dent on the left door

list_items.text: (a) pay the rent on time and keep the standing order active;
(b) look after the property and report any damage promptly, in particular:
(i) leaks, damp or any sign of water ingress;
(ii) faults with the heating or the hot water;
(iii) broken locks, windows or door entry equipment;
(c) allow access for repairs on at least 24 hours' written notice;
(d) not sublet any part of the property without the landlord's written consent.
• keep the structure, the exterior and the installations for water, gas and electricity in repair;
• protect the deposit in an approved scheme within 30 days of receiving it;
• give the tenant a copy of the gas safety certificate and the energy performance certificate;
• respond to reports of urgent repairs within 48 hours.
[x] Smoke alarms tested in the hall and the kitchen
[x] Carbon monoxide alarm fitted next to the boiler
[x] Meter readings recorded: electricity, gas and water
[ ] Window restrictor in the second bedroom to be fitted
[ ] Replacement key for the bin store to be supplied
